open_points.question: What exact exported constant name must the generated code import for the owner form table?

witness.initial: The release data provider must expose the owner form table, and generated owner-interface code must read it.
events: One implementer exports and imports the table as OWNER_FORM_FIELDS, following the formerly explicit name.
Another implementer exports and imports the table as OWNER_FORM_TABLE, reading the revised text as deliberately withdrawing the former name.
A later generator or module imports the name chosen independently for the same table.
outcomes: The independently chosen names match, so generation and loading succeed.
The independently chosen names differ, so the import or generated-code build fails even though both implementations satisfy 'a constant of the data provider'.
witness.observer: The later code generator, build system, or developer integrating the data provider with the generated owner-interface code
